svg.text: Three independent channels: shape = category, colour = scope, text = exact type and technology.
1 · Shape — what kind of thing it is
2 · Colour — how much of it is ours
Highlight, at most one per diagram
Cylinder and pipe carry name + «type» only — the domed cap eats the description line.
